name: Seamless Tile Pattern Maker and Checker

seo.title: Seamless Tile Pattern Maker and Checker — Browser-Local Tool
seo.meta_description: Preview an image as a 3×3 tile, quantify opposite-edge mismatch and optionally create an offset working copy for seam repair.

assumptions: Edge mismatch is computed from sampled RGB differences along opposite borders.
limitations: A low numeric edge score does not prove a pattern is visually seamless, especially for structured motifs.
